page.overview:
Who is Harrison Marsh?

Harrison Marsh is a character created by American author Armand Rosamilia for his Keyport Cthulhu series of Mythos tales.

At the beginning of the cycle, Harrison appeared as a youngish man with no distinguishing features. As his Innsmouth heritage began to assert itself, he gradually came to resemble his kinfolk, losing most of his hair and his skin taking on an unhealthy pallor.

It is worth noting that although Harrison comes from Innsmouth stock, he is considered of "weak blood" by those of the Esoteric Order of Dagon. Why this might be the case is not explained.

After coming to Keyport with his wife Nicole to settle his grandfather's estate, Nicole was abducted by the local chapter of the Esoteric Order of Dagon and used as a sacrifice to awaken Great Cthulhu. Despite Harrison's best efforts, he was unable to rescue her, and quickly began to assume the traits of his blood, the proximity to others of his kind apparently being the catalyst.
